edits.before: This is pure outscaling and the matchup is yours. Swain is a finite drain-scaler whose soul stacks plateau, and you're the canonical hyper-carry; once Nashor's plus your E missing-health on-hit is online you out-DPS his R drain, and at level 16 your fully-ranged AoE autos under R invuln shred his entire soul-stacked HP bar faster than his R can heal it. The only thing that kills you is getting caught by a flank E root with R down, so hold R for his engage and never facecheck. Take every extended fight where you can stand outside his E and let your range do the work.
edits.after: This is pure outscaling and the matchup is yours. What kills you is a flank Nevermove root with R down, so hold R for his engage and never facecheck. Take every fight you can take from outside his E.
